podcast.title: Lack of Public Interest
podcast.body: This group, formed by Chris Novoselic with a member of the Meat Puppets and the drummer from Sublime, failed to generate public interest and was finished by 2003. "However, nobody cared, and by 2003 that particular band was finished."

xref.title: Drummer's Involvement in Eyes Adrift
xref.body: The drummer from Sublime was a member of Chris Novoselic's post-Nirvana band, Eyes Adrift. "and the drummer from Sublime."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Eyes Adrift Formation and Disbandment
xref.body: Following Sweet 75, Chris formed Eyes Adrift with a member of the Meat Puppets (one of Nirvana's favorite bands) and the drummer from Sublime. This band also failed to attract an audience and was finished by 2003. "That was followed by a group called Eyes Adrift, with a guy from the Meet Puppets, one of Nirvana's favorite bands, and the drummer from Sublime."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Member's Involvement in Eyes Adrift
xref.body: A member of the Meat Puppets, described as "one of Nirvana's favorite bands," joined Chris Novoselic in his post-Nirvana band, Eyes Adrift. "That was followed by a group called Eyes Adrift, with a guy from the Meet Puppets, one of Nirvana's favorite bands"
